rawContent: #OTD: February 26, 2012, Trayvon Martin was murdered. Just 17-years old, he was racially profiled on his way back from a convenience store in Sanford, FL. The acquittal of his murderer in 2013 led three Black women to say #BlackLivesMatter and help spark a movement. https://t.co/2jQr7l5ufm
